label: The Transfiguration of the Lord (Gregorian Missal)

chants.vernacular_text: My heart declared to you: "Your countenance have I sought; I shall ever seek your countenance, O Lord; do not turn your face from me." ℣. The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?

Your beauty surpasses that of all the children of men; grace is poured out upon your lips. ℣. My heart overflows with a goodly theme; I address my works to the King; my tongue is like the pen of an agile scribe.
He is the splendour of eternal light, an unspotted mirror and the image of His goodness.
You have crowned him with glory and honour, and you have placed him over the work of your hands, O Lord.
As for the vision you have seen, tell no one until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.
